words.example: The scientist promised to come back to China after finishing her study abroad.

words.zh: phr. 人行横道线（斑马线）
words.example: Students should walk on the zebra crossing to cross the street safely.

words.zh: phr. 嘲笑
words.example: We should never laugh at people who are trying their best to improve.

words.zh: phr. 好像，仿佛
words.example: The little girl talked as if she had grown up all by herself.

words.zh: phr. 意外地；偶然
words.example: I found the answer to the question by accident in an old magazine.

words.zh: phr. 事实上，其实
words.example: As a matter of fact, I have already finished the book report.

words.zh: phr. 关掉（水、电、电视、收音机等）
words.example: Please turn off the air conditioner when you leave the classroom.

words.zh: phr. 逐渐地，不久以后
words.example: By and by, the sky cleared and the sun came out again.

words.zh: phr. 有一点，有点；一会儿
words.example: The new teacher is a bit nervous on her first day of class.

words.zh: phr. 参考；涉及；指的是；适用于；谈到
words.example: This chart refers to the population change in the past fifty years.

words.zh: quant. 总共；共计；  phr. 总共；共计
words.example: There are twenty-four students in our group in all, including me.

words.zh: phr. 连接，相连；联结
words.example: The cable at the back of the TV connects to the computer easily.

words.zh: phr. 保留，阻止，阻挡，隐瞒
words.example: She tried to keep back her excitement when she received the award.

words.zh: phr. …或者…；不是…就是…
words.example: You can either write an essay or draw a poster for the project.

words.zh: phr. 与……相比；将......比做
words.example: Teachers often compare the brain to a computer in science class.

words.zh: phr. 来回，来来回回；上上下下，起伏；上下波动
words.example: The little boy jumped up and down with excitement at the playground.

words.zh: phr. 依靠，相信，信赖
words.example: Many students depend on online resources to finish their homework.

words.zh: phr. 快餐馆；小吃店
words.example: We bought some sandwiches at the snack bar after the basketball game.

words.zh: phr. 公共汽车站
words.example: Please wait for me at the bus stop near the school gate.

words.zh: phr. 总之，简言之
words.example: In a word, keeping a balanced diet is vital for teenagers.

words.zh: phr. 过得愉快，玩得高兴
words.example: The children enjoyed themselves during the school trip to the museum.

words.zh: phr. 在⋯⋯前面；【数】在...之前
words.example: A new library stands in front of the teaching building.

words.zh: n. （跳绳用）绳
words.example: The first-graders brought a colorful skipping rope to the playground.

words.zh: phr. 走过，过去；（时间）流逝；叫作，被称为
words.example: As time goes by, we learn to value our friendships more.

words.zh: n. 人
words.example: Every human being has the right to receive a good education.

words.zh: phr. 坚持下去；不挂断；稍等；握住不放
words.example: Hang on, I need to grab my coat before we leave.

words.zh: phr. 生病
words.example: Several students fell ill after eating lunch in the cafeteria.

words.zh: phr. 一块，一张，一根，一片
words.example: She gave me a piece of cake from her birthday party.

words.zh: n. 原材料，原料；  phr. 原材料
words.example: Wood is a raw material used to make furniture and paper.

words.zh: phr. 散步
words.example: Let's go for a walk along the river after dinner.

words.zh: phr. 患感冒
words.example: I have a cold and should stay home from school today.

words.zh: n. 服务费，小费
words.example: The restaurant adds a ten percent service charge to every bill.

words.zh: phr. 为了，以便
words.example: He studied hard so as to pass the math examination.

words.zh: phr. 试穿，试试看
words.example: You should try the blue shirt on before buying it.

words.zh: phr. 太……以至于……
words.example: The test was so difficult that many students needed extra time.

words.zh: phr. 最后，终于
words.example: In the end, our team won the match through hard work.

words.zh: phr. 对……严格要求
words.example: Our teacher is strict with us about handing in homework on time.

words.zh: phr. 变为现实
words.example: After years of effort, her dream finally came true.

words.zh: n. 岔道
words.example: The driver turned into a side road to avoid traffic.

words.zh: adv. 再一次
words.example: Please read the instructions once more before starting the experiment.

words.zh: phr. 选出，找出，挑选
words.example: The coach helped me pick out a new basketball at the sports shop.

words.zh: phr. 一种，一类
words.example: Bamboo is a kind of grass that can grow very tall.

words.zh: phr. 出毛病，运转不正常
words.example: The vending machine in the hallway is out of order again.

words.zh: phr. 匆忙，很快地
words.example: She left for school in a hurry and forgot her keys.

words.zh: phr. 倒塌；下降；流传下来；患（病），染上（小病）；落下来；从……下来
words.example: Heavy rain caused the old building to come down.

words.zh: phr. 按顺序；整齐地
words.example: Please put the books back in order after you finish reading.

words.zh: phr. 拿起，捡起；搭载；逮捕，拘捕；接电话；获得，学会；搭讪；买，购买；举起；取（某物）；接（电话），拿起
words.example: I need to pick up my brother from school at four o'clock.

words.zh: phr. 好；顺利的；正确的；行了，好吧；合适的
words.example: It will be all right if we check the map before leaving.

words.zh: phr. 从今以后，今后
words.example: From now on, I will spend more time reading English aloud.

words.zh: phr. 停止做某事
words.example: You should stop playing video games and start your homework.
